decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation extends the firm's laser line, has been listed on the website for two years, and fits the firm's single-source strategy, so management will keep it despite its lower visibility.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer is close to the firm's core business, has had its own page for two years, and anchors the firm's coding portfolio.
The piezo inkjet printer has had its own page for two years and is central to matching technologies to each surface, so the firm's sunk investment and commitment favor keeping it.
Featured on the home page, the industrial laser marking systems are a flagship of the firm's announced direction, making a drop very unlikely.
